text.p: Indian castorseed June delivery prices on Wednesday bounced back to 1,175/1,176 rupees per quintal from 1,171/1,172 rupees on fresh speculative buying, dealers said.
"Fresh overseas buying however remained low but short- covering and limited inflows sent prices up," a dealer said.

Arrivals of castorseed in the Gujarat region dropped to 20,000/25,000 bags (75 kg each) from 30,000/35,000 bags reported on Tuesday due to unseasonal weather coupled with an ongoing strike by transport operators.
Groundnut oil was steady at 352/354 rupees per 10 kg amid limited inflows of 20/30 tonnes while physical buying was at a low ebb.
Supplies were low due to the transport strike.
Imported palm oil was steady at 284/285 rupees per 15 kg.
In Rajkot spot groundnut oil was steady at 530/535 rupees per 15 kg. -- Bombay Commodities +91-22-265 9000
